description: This Kotlin source file defines the IdMappingRepository class, which provides methods to manage IdMapping entities via the IdMappingDao data access object. It handles inserting, updating, assigning provider notes, and retrieving mappings based on local IDs or cloud service providers.

classes.name: IdMappingRepository
classes.description: Repository class that manages IdMapping entities, interfacing with the data access object to perform CRUD operations and specific queries related to ID mappings.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Asynchronously inserts one or more IdMapping objects into the database via the DAO.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Asynchronously updates existing IdMapping objects in the database.

methods.name: assignProviderToNote
methods.description: Assigns a provider to a note mapping. If a non-remote mapping exists, updates it; otherwise, inserts a new mapping.

methods.name: getAllByLocalId
methods.description: Retrieves all mappings associated with a specific local ID.

methods.name: getAllByProvider
methods.description: Retrieves all mappings associated with a specific cloud service provider.
